entry.summary: -from Her Worship the Mayor of Kawerau Faylene Tunui, on behalf of all current and former Kawerau councillors and staff:Nā koutou i tangi, nā tatau katoa / when you mourn, your tears are shed by us allIt is with a grief-stricken heart that I share the passing of former Mayor of Kawerau Malcolm Campbell MNZM JP.The community of Kawerau knows Malcolm well, because he was one of us.   Malcolm was born in 1952. He was one of the early pupils at Kawerau Central School and Kawerau District High (as it was known then).
